product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series 4x1 TV Wall Mount for Portrait Display Menu Boards Fits 32 to 65 TVs with Adjustable Tilt
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series 4×1 TV Wall Mount for Portrait Display Menu Boards – Fits 32"–65" TVs with Adjustable TiltThe Monoprice Commercial Series 4×1 TV Wall Mount is designed for professional menu board and digital signage installations using four portrait-oriented displays mounted directly to a wall. It supports 32" to 65" TVs, provides adjustable tilt for improved readability, and delivers a clean, wall-mounted alternative to ceiling-based menu board systems. This mount is ideal for applications that require additional screen capacity over a 3×1 layout while maintaining a compact, low-profile wall installation.4×1 portrait configuration mounts four displays in a single vertical column using a wall-mounted rail systemSupports 32" to 65" TVs with adjustable tilt up to 15° per display for optimized viewing anglesWall-mounted design with no ceiling drop – ideal for spaces with low ceilings or architectural constraintsRail length of approximately 1045 mm (41.1 in) for consistent display spacing and alignment90° portrait orientation support for vertical menu board and digital signage applicationsCommercial-grade steel construction with included wall anchors, lag bolts, and assorted fastenersDesigned for indoor commercial use only; professional installation recommendedRegulatory compliance: RoHS, REACH, TSCA 6(h), Prop 65, EU POP FOUR PORTRAIT DISPLAYS IN A VERTICAL WALL LAYOUTThe mount is engineered for a 4×1 portrait configuration, stacking four displays in a single vertical column using a wall-mounted rail system. This design increases content capacity compared to a 3×1 wall mount while preserving consistent spacing and alignment across all four screens. ADJUSTABLE TILT FOR IMPROVED VIEWING ANGLESEach display interface supports fixed tilt positions up to 15°, allowing installers to optimize viewing angles based on mounting height and viewer distance – essential for menu boards mounted high on restaurant or retail walls. WALL MOUNTED DESIGN WITH NO CEILING DROPThis model mounts directly to a load-bearing wall using lag bolts and anchors, eliminating the need for ceiling poles. The wall mount design reduces visual clutter and simplifies installation in spaces with low ceilings or architectural constraints. PORTRAIT ORIENTATION SUPPORTThe mount supports 90° portrait orientation, ensuring secure alignment for vertically mounted displays commonly used in menu boards, promotional signage, and information kiosks in commercial environments. COMMERCIAL GRADE STEEL CONSTRUCTIONSteel construction with included wall mounting hardware supports secure, long-term installation. The mount is intended for indoor commercial use only and should be installed by qualified professionals following all safety guidelines. PACKAGE CONTENTS• Vertical wall mount rail (4-screen configuration)• Four display mounting brackets• Wall anchors and lag bolts• Assorted M5, M6, and M8 fasteners• Installation hardware pack• Printed user manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
